verdict.rationale: Retell documents an official CLI for managing agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases and other resources from the terminal, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Command-level depth, agent- or scripting-oriented features, and any independent hands-on use are not evidenced. missing for 10: detailed command reference and auth/output-format documentation (e.g. JSON/scriptable output for AI workflows), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install the Retell CLI to manage agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, and other Retell resources from your terminal with simple commands.
The Retell CLI lets you manage Retell resources from your terminal.
